messages:
harper: Heads-up: our GH Actions workflow failed after nightly key rotation. Sampleapp in staging kept 401ing even though REDWOOD_API_KEY was updated.

riley: Which env did CI actually rotate? REDWOOD_API_KEY only?

harper: Yes. CI rotates REDWOOD_API_KEY. But staging container also had LEGACY_RW_TOKEN set (from old templates) so the running process kept authing with that.

devon: Ah, classic mixed-secret problem. Do we have a precedence doc? SDKs used to prefer legacy names for org/project fallbacks.

harper: No doc, and different SDK versions behave differently. Quick repro I ran:
```bash
# before rotation
export LEGACY_RW_TOKEN=oldtok
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=newtok
./start-server  # still auths with LEGACY_RW_TOKEN
```

riley: Short fix: update rotate helper to write *all* known env names in the deployment templates so rotation is atomic across pinned SDKs.

katie: Agreed. Also we should add a runtime reload signal in sampleapp to re-init client on SIGHUP. Many containers don't restart on secret update.

devon: For SDKs: emit a single-line deprecation warning when a legacy env is present and link to migration doc. That prevents silent breakage.

rotation-bot: Created issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/612, https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-templates/issues/204

harper: We should also add a GH Actions snippet to onboarding: show how to rotate a single secret (REDWOOD_API_KEY) and remove others from repo settings. Example: replace secret and then restart workflow using workflow_dispatch.

riley: Also flag streaming clients: if auth happens at websocket handshake, rotate mid-connection may require a reconnect. Add a blurb: "Servers should fail fast on auth error and clients should reconnect and re-auth."

katie: Plan: 1) emergency rotate-helper patch to write legacy names in templates (merge today), 2) sampleapp: add SIGHUP reload and e2e that runs rotate-and-restart, 3) SDK: deprecation warning + migration doc, 4) onboarding: GH Actions secret hygiene example.

devon: I'll open the SDK PR and a tiny compatibility shim that logs the warning. harper 1: can you add the GH Actions snippet in the onboarding page?

harper: Yep, will PR the docs and ping for review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
